implementation.name: reDIP SID gateware
implementation.notes: License: CERN-OHL-S-2.0, read from https://github.com/daglem/reDIP-SID/blob/master/LICENSE (the verbatim "CERN Open Hardware Licence Version 2 - Strongly Reciprocal" text); the same identifier appears in each gateware source header. accuracy_id from the README: "Cycle accurate emulation of the SID chip has been implemented in gateware/." No implementation_chip row: the MOS 6581/8580 SID is not catalogued under data/chip/. Platform is "other" because the target is the project's own DIP-28 Lattice iCE40UP5K board, not one of the named retro platforms. This gateware is also the upstream of the SID filter and DAC used by MiSTer-devel/C64_MiSTer.
